name: i64
note: an index; its bound is a property (master 5's ix.D)

name: size
note: a length or a trip count, rendered as Futhark's i64; its only terminal is var@size, and no row returns it

name: []{E}
note: an array of elements; its length is a property

name: [][]{E}
note: an array of rows; its two lengths are properties (master 5's a.D.D and A7's mat.P)

name: ({A}, {B})
note: a pair of elements (a loop's destructured state)

name: ({A}, {B}, {C})
note: a triple of elements (the Kahan loop's state)

name: []f32 -> []f32
note: a row function; every row function of the master keeps its row's length

name: []f32 -> []f32 -> []f32
note: a binary row function, on two rows of one length (map2_rows fits them first); it keeps that length
